title: cPanel security advisory (AV26-861)
description: As of August 27, 2026, cPanel is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
cPanel & WebHost Manager (WHM) software
	Prior to 11.110.0.141
Prior to 11.134.0.53
Prior to 11.136.0.37
Prior to 11.138.0.2
Prior to WP2: 11.138.1.7
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
